namespace App\Services;

use App\Order;
use App\UserSelfieHistory;
use InvalidArgumentException;

class MatchedSearchOrders
{
    /**
     * Resolve an internal search-history ID to all explicitly linked orders.
     * The caller must establish the ID's provenance; this does not verify a
     * person, a recognition score, payment, or discount eligibility.
     *
     * @param int|string $historyId
     * @return \Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Collection
     */
    public static function forHistoryId($historyId)
    {
        if ((!is_int($historyId) && !is_string($historyId)) ||
            filter_var($historyId, FILTER_VALIDATE_INT, ['options' => ['min_range' => 1]]) === false) {
            throw new InvalidArgumentException('A positive search-history ID is required.');
        }

        $history = UserSelfieHistory::query()->findOrFail($historyId);

        return Order::query()
            ->where('selfie_search_id', $history->getKey())
            ->orderBy('order_id')
            ->get();
    }
}

            if ($key !== $index || !is_array($match) || !array_key_exists('externalImageId', $match)) {
                throw new InvalidArgumentException('Each match must be an ordered list entry containing externalImageId.');
            }
            $results[] = [
                'match' => $match,
                'reference_evidence' => static::forReference($collectionId, $match['externalImageId']),
            ];
            $index++;
        }

        return $results;
    }

    /**
     * Resolve one reference in the caller's search collection context.
     * This does not authenticate the reference or establish a person match,
     * confidence, location eligibility, or entitlement to a discount.
     */
    public static function forReference($collectionId, $externalImageId)
    {
        $prefix = SearchRecognitionRegistration::EXTERNAL_ID_PREFIX;
        if ($collectionId !== SearchRecognitionRegistration::COLLECTION_ID ||
            !is_string($externalImageId) ||
            !preg_match('/\\A' . preg_quote($prefix, '/') . '([1-9][0-9]*)\\z/', $externalImageId, $matches)) {
            throw new InvalidArgumentException('A canonical search recognition reference is required.');
        }

        $historyId = filter_var($matches[1], FILTER_VALIDATE_INT, ['options' => ['min_range' => 1]]);
        if ($historyId === false) {
            throw new InvalidArgumentException('The search recognition ID is outside the supported integer range.');
        }

        return [
            'collection_id' => $collectionId,
            'external_image_id' => $externalImageId,
            'purchase_evidence' => SearchPaymentEvidence::forHistoryId($historyId),
        ];
    }
}

namespace App\Services;

use App\Payments;
use InvalidArgumentException;

class RecordedPaymentEvidence
{
    /**
     * Inspect application records, not gateway settlement or discount eligibility.
     * The caller must establish the order's search/person/location provenance.
     */
    public static function forOrderId($orderId)
    {
        if ((!is_int($orderId) && !is_string($orderId)) ||
            filter_var($orderId, FILTER_VALIDATE_INT, ['options' => ['min_range' => 1]]) === false) {
            throw new InvalidArgumentException('A positive order ID is required.');
        }

        $payments = Payments::query()
            ->leftJoin('status', 'payment.status_id', '=', 'status.status_id')
            ->where('payment.order_id', $orderId)
            ->orderBy('payment.payment_id')
            ->get([
                'payment.payment_id', 'payment.amount', 'payment.deleted',
                'payment.transaction_id', 'payment.square_transaction_id',
                'payment.transaction_response_code', 'status.name as recorded_status',
            ]);

        $classification = 'not-established';
        $records = [];
        foreach ($payments as $payment) {
            list($decision, $reason) = self::classifyRecord($payment);
            $records[] = [
                'payment_id' => $payment->payment_id,
                'classification' => $decision,
                'reason' => $reason,
            ];
            if ($decision === 'recorded-success' ||
                ($decision === 'unresolved' && $classification === 'not-established')) {
                $classification = $decision;
            }
        }

        return ['order_id' => (int) $orderId, 'classification' => $classification, 'records' => $records];
    }

    private static function classifyRecord(Payments $payment)
    {
        if ($payment->deleted !== null) {
            return ['not-established', 'deleted-record'];
        }
        if (in_array($payment->recorded_status, ['failed', 'active', 'payment canceled'], true)) {
            return ['not-established', 'non-success-status'];
        }

        // Only the sign matters. Avoid rounding decimal payment amounts through floats.
        $amount = (string) $payment->amount;
        if (!preg_match('/^-?\d+(?:\.\d+)?$/D', $amount)) {
            return ['unresolved', 'invalid-amount'];
        }
        if ($amount[0] === '-' || !preg_match('/[1-9]/', $amount)) {
            return ['not-established', 'nonpositive-amount'];
        }
        if ($payment->recorded_status !== 'approved') {
            return ['unresolved', 'unknown-status'];
        }

        $square = trim((string) $payment->square_transaction_id) !== '';
        $transaction = trim((string) $payment->transaction_id) !== '';
        $response = (string) $payment->transaction_response_code;
        if ($square && !$transaction && $response === '') {
            return ['recorded-success', 'square-recorded-success'];
        }
        if ($transaction && !$square && $response === '1') {
            return ['recorded-success', 'authorize-recorded-success'];
        }
        if ($transaction && !$square && $response === 'succeeded') {
            return ['recorded-success', 'stripe-recorded-success'];
        }

        return ['unresolved', 'unrecognized-success-format'];
    }
}

namespace App\Services;

class SearchPaymentEvidence
{
    /**
     * Connect a supplied search to its recorded payment evidence.
     * This does not establish person identity, location eligibility or settlement.
     * Unknown and malformed history IDs retain the lookup service's exceptions.
     */
    public static function forHistoryId($historyId)
    {
        $linkedOrders = MatchedSearchOrders::forHistoryId($historyId);
        $orders = [];
        $classification = 'not-established';

        foreach ($linkedOrders as $order) {
            $evidence = RecordedPaymentEvidence::forOrderId($order->order_id);
            $orders[] = $evidence;

            if ($evidence['classification'] === 'recorded-success' ||
                ($evidence['classification'] === 'unresolved' && $classification === 'not-established')) {
                $classification = $evidence['classification'];
            }
        }

        return [
            'search_history_id' => (int) $historyId,
            'classification' => $classification,
            'orders' => $orders,
        ];
    }
}

namespace App\Services;

use App\Helpers\AmazonFaceRecognitionService;
use App\UserSelfieHistory;
use InvalidArgumentException;

class SearchRecognitionRegistration
{
    const COLLECTION_ID = 'purchase-search-history';
    const EXTERNAL_ID_PREFIX = 'search-history-';

    /**
     * Register an explicitly supplied search using its own recognition reference.
     * The caller configures the helper. This does not establish a person match,
     * payment, location eligibility, or a durable local indexed flag.
     */
    public static function registerForHistoryId($historyId, AmazonFaceRecognitionService $amazon)
    {
        if ((!is_int($historyId) && !is_string($historyId)) ||
            filter_var($historyId, FILTER_VALIDATE_INT, ['options' => ['min_range' => 1]]) === false) {
            throw new InvalidArgumentException('A positive search-history ID is required.');
        }

        $history = UserSelfieHistory::query()->findOrFail($historyId);
        // Only recorded presence matters here; no timestamp conversion is needed.
        $recorded = $history->getAttributes();
        if (empty($recorded['consent_given_at']) || empty($recorded['search_completed_at']) ||
            !is_array($history->matched_image_ids) || !$history->matched_image_ids) {
            throw new InvalidArgumentException('The search requires recorded consent and completed photo results.');
        }

        $bucket = AmazonFaceRecognitionService::$AmazonFaceRecognitionBucketName;
        $region = AmazonFaceRecognitionService::$AmazonFaceRecognitionRegion;
        if ($history->storage_provider !== 'amazon' ||
            !is_string($history->s3_key) || trim($history->s3_key) === '' ||
            !is_string($bucket) || $bucket === '' || !is_string($region) || $region === '' ||
            $history->s3_bucket !== $bucket || $history->s3_region !== $region) {
            throw new InvalidArgumentException('The search image must belong to the configured Amazon bucket and region.');
        }

        $result = [
            'search_history_id' => (int) $history->getKey(),
            'collection_id' => self::COLLECTION_ID,
            'external_image_id' => self::EXTERNAL_ID_PREFIX . $history->getKey(),
            'status' => 'not-registered',
            'face_ids' => [],
        ];

        if ($amazon->createCollection(self::COLLECTION_ID) !== true) {
            return $result;
        }

        $faceIds = $amazon->indexFaceInCollection(
            $history->s3_key,
            self::COLLECTION_ID,
            $result['external_image_id']
        );
        if (!is_array($faceIds) || count($faceIds) !== 1 ||
            !isset($faceIds[0]) || !is_string($faceIds[0]) || trim($faceIds[0]) === '') {
            return $result;
        }

        $result['status'] = 'registered';
        $result['face_ids'] = $faceIds;

        return $result;
    }
}

namespace App\Services;

use InvalidArgumentException;

class RecognitionPurchaseEvidence
{
    /**
     * Preserve every returned match alongside its complete reference evidence.
     * A successful empty list is distinct from provider failure sentinels.
     * This does not decide whether a match establishes identity or eligibility.
     */
    public static function forMatches($collectionId, $matches)
    {
        if ($collectionId !== SearchRecognitionRegistration::COLLECTION_ID || !is_array($matches)) {
            throw new InvalidArgumentException('The search collection and a successful match list are required.');
        }

        $results = [];
        $index = 0;
        foreach ($matches as $key => $match) {
            if ($key !== $index || !is_array($match) || !array_key_exists('externalImageId', $match)) {
                throw new InvalidArgumentException('Each match must be an ordered list entry containing externalImageId.');
            }
            $results[] = [
                'match' => $match,
                'reference_evidence' => static::forReference($collectionId, $match['externalImageId']),
            ];
            $index++;
        }

        return $results;
    }

    /**
     * Resolve one reference in the caller's search collection context.
     * This does not authenticate the reference or establish a person match,
     * confidence, location eligibility, or entitlement to a discount.
     */
    public static function forReference($collectionId, $externalImageId)
    {
        $prefix = SearchRecognitionRegistration::EXTERNAL_ID_PREFIX;
        if ($collectionId !== SearchRecognitionRegistration::COLLECTION_ID ||
            !is_string($externalImageId) ||
            !preg_match('/\\A' . preg_quote($prefix, '/') . '([1-9][0-9]*)\\z/', $externalImageId, $matches)) {
            throw new InvalidArgumentException('A canonical search recognition reference is required.');
        }

        $historyId = filter_var($matches[1], FILTER_VALIDATE_INT, ['options' => ['min_range' => 1]]);
        if ($historyId === false) {
            throw new InvalidArgumentException('The search recognition ID is outside the supported integer range.');
        }

        return [
            'collection_id' => $collectionId,
            'external_image_id' => $externalImageId,
            'purchase_evidence' => SearchPaymentEvidence::forHistoryId($historyId),
        ];
    }
}

namespace App\Services;

use App\Payments;
use InvalidArgumentException;

class RecordedPaymentEvidence
{
    /**
     * Inspect application records, not gateway settlement or discount eligibility.
     * The caller must establish the order's search/person/location provenance.
     */
    public static function forOrderId($orderId)
    {
        if ((!is_int($orderId) && !is_string($orderId)) ||
            filter_var($orderId, FILTER_VALIDATE_INT, ['options' => ['min_range' => 1]]) === false) {
            throw new InvalidArgumentException('A positive order ID is required.');
        }

        $payments = Payments::query()
            ->leftJoin('status', 'payment.status_id', '=', 'status.status_id')
            ->where('payment.order_id', $orderId)
            ->orderBy('payment.payment_id')
            ->get([
                'payment.payment_id', 'payment.amount', 'payment.deleted',
                'payment.transaction_id', 'payment.square_transaction_id',
                'payment.transaction_response_code', 'status.name as recorded_status',
            ]);

        $classification = 'not-established';
        $records = [];
        foreach ($payments as $payment) {
            list($decision, $reason) = self::classifyRecord($payment);
            $records[] = [
                'payment_id' => $payment->payment_id,
                'classification' => $decision,
                'reason' => $reason,
            ];
            if ($decision === 'recorded-success' ||
                ($decision === 'unresolved' && $classification === 'not-established')) {
                $classification = $decision;
            }
        }

        return ['order_id' => (int) $orderId, 'classification' => $classification, 'records' => $records];
    }

    private static function classifyRecord(Payments $payment)
    {
        if ($payment->deleted !== null) {
            return ['not-established', 'deleted-record'];
        }
        if (in_array($payment->recorded_status, ['failed', 'active', 'payment canceled'], true)) {
            return ['not-established', 'non-success-status'];
        }

        // Only the sign matters. Avoid rounding decimal payment amounts through floats.
        $amount = (string) $payment->amount;
        if (!preg_match('/^-?\d+(?:\.\d+)?$/D', $amount)) {
            return ['unresolved', 'invalid-amount'];
        }
        if ($amount[0] === '-' || !preg_match('/[1-9]/', $amount)) {
            return ['not-established', 'nonpositive-amount'];
        }
        if ($payment->recorded_status !== 'approved') {
            return ['unresolved', 'unknown-status'];
        }

        $square = trim((string) $payment->square_transaction_id) !== '';
        $transaction = trim((string) $payment->transaction_id) !== '';
        $response = (string) $payment->transaction_response_code;
        if ($square && !$transaction && $response === '') {
            return ['recorded-success', 'square-recorded-success'];
        }
        if ($transaction && !$square && $response === '1') {
            return ['recorded-success', 'authorize-recorded-success'];
        }
        if ($transaction && !$square && $response === 'succeeded') {
            return ['recorded-success', 'stripe-recorded-success'];
        }

        return ['unresolved', 'unrecognized-success-format'];
    }
}

namespace App\Services;

use App\Helpers\AmazonFaceRecognitionService;
use App\UserSelfieHistory;
use InvalidArgumentException;

class SearchRecognitionRegistration
{
    const COLLECTION_ID = 'purchase-search-history';
    const EXTERNAL_ID_PREFIX = 'search-history-';

    /**
     * Register an explicitly supplied search using its own recognition reference.
     * The caller configures the helper. This does not establish a person match,
     * payment, location eligibility, or a durable local indexed flag.
     */
    public static function registerForHistoryId($historyId, AmazonFaceRecognitionService $amazon)
    {
        if ((!is_int($historyId) && !is_string($historyId)) ||
            filter_var($historyId, FILTER_VALIDATE_INT, ['options' => ['min_range' => 1]]) === false) {
            throw new InvalidArgumentException('A positive search-history ID is required.');
        }

        $history = UserSelfieHistory::query()->findOrFail($historyId);
        // Only recorded presence matters here; no timestamp conversion is needed.
        $recorded = $history->getAttributes();
        if (empty($recorded['consent_given_at']) || empty($recorded['search_completed_at']) ||
            !is_array($history->matched_image_ids) || !$history->matched_image_ids) {
            throw new InvalidArgumentException('The search requires recorded consent and completed photo results.');
        }

        $bucket = AmazonFaceRecognitionService::$AmazonFaceRecognitionBucketName;
        $region = AmazonFaceRecognitionService::$AmazonFaceRecognitionRegion;
        if ($history->storage_provider !== 'amazon' ||
            !is_string($history->s3_key) || trim($history->s3_key) === '' ||
            !is_string($bucket) || $bucket === '' || !is_string($region) || $region === '' ||
            $history->s3_bucket !== $bucket || $history->s3_region !== $region) {
            throw new InvalidArgumentException('The search image must belong to the configured Amazon bucket and region.');
        }

        $result = [
            'search_history_id' => (int) $history->getKey(),
            'collection_id' => self::COLLECTION_ID,
            'external_image_id' => self::EXTERNAL_ID_PREFIX . $history->getKey(),
            'status' => 'not-registered',
            'face_ids' => [],
        ];

        if ($amazon->createCollection(self::COLLECTION_ID) !== true) {
            return $result;
        }

        $faceIds = $amazon->indexFaceInCollection(
            $history->s3_key,
            self::COLLECTION_ID,
            $result['external_image_id']
        );
        if (!is_array($faceIds) || count($faceIds) !== 1 ||
            !isset($faceIds[0]) || !is_string($faceIds[0]) || trim($faceIds[0]) === '') {
            return $result;
        }

        $result['status'] = 'registered';
        $result['face_ids'] = $faceIds;

        return $result;
    }
}
